profile_text.body:
Appian Corp is a for-profit public company headquartered in McLean, Virginia, trading under the ticker APPN. Its website describes the company as providing AI automation for critical business processes, orchestrating AI agents, systems, and people on an enterprise platform without replacing existing systems. The company says it has been automating processes for more than 25 years and serves the world's largest organizations.

The site states that Appian was named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies (BOAT). It promotes capabilities including AI-powered process automation for accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoice processing, reconciliation, sourcing, contracts, supplier data, audit workflows, case resolution, procure-to-pay, onboarding, order management, and contract review. The company says customers can build AI-powered apps with no code and embed AI agents to extract data, act autonomously, and generate code from natural language prompts. It also cites an AI Value Study with Harvard Business Review Analytic Services and claims onboarding time can be cut by up to 50%.

Appian Corp's SEC Central Index Key is 0001441683, and its record lists 152 law exposure entries in Virginia. The company is also known as APPIAN CORP-A.
